Boom, which also contains lots of herbs and nuts and is delicious, 400 yen in Japanese yen
Dec 2024 • Solo
It is a street stall on the corner near Takashimaya, one block from Ben Thanh Market.

There is a blue menu card sign,
Many plastic containers to take home are stacked on top of each other so you can instantly tell.
I ordered the most famous one, the up-spring roll, and no broth of yakiniku.
I paid the money (65,000 VND = about 400 yen) on the spot.
Your young brother speaks English.
I told them I was going to eat on the spot, and they followed me to the sidewalk across the street.
They put out tables and chairs and made seats for us.
After a while, the food was brought in.

It was quite spicy compared to Japan when you tasted Bun sauce
When I poured everything over the noodles and mixed them, they tasted just right because they were sweet and spicy.
Not only do they make it, but they also have a lot of herbs and nuts underneath the noodles.
It was so delicious and filled me up more than I looked.

Must try in HCMC!

This was one of the best meals I had during my 2 ½ week trip through Vietnam. I know it might be a little intimidating to eat at a place like this if you had not done it before, but just walk up, grab a chair and enjoy. The grilled pork had a yummy smoky flavor and the spring roll was delicious. My boyfriend was hesitant to eat here (as he didn’t want to get sick) but then kept steaking bites of my food because it was so good.
